description: Calls a registered Fabrix Function (POST /functions/{id}/execute/) and writes its output to the rule's target_field

description: Extracts a value from raw HTML/DOM content using a CSS selector chain with fallback alternatives — the deterministic sibling of 'prompt'
name: Selector

selector.description: Primary CSS selector (or list of selectors, first-match-wins)

alternatives.description: Ordered fallback configs (same shape as this action's params), tried if the primary yields nothing

attr.description: DOM attribute to read instead of text content, e.g. src/content/data-sku

regex.description: {pattern, extract_group} applied to the matched text/script content

multiple.description: Scan all matches (e.g. every <script> tag) instead of the first

decodeEntities.description: Decode HTML entities in the extracted text

replace.description: [[from, to], ...] string replacements applied before transform

joinWith.description: Separator used when multiple matches are joined into one string

description: Replaces the rule target_field value with a consistent random scramble (same input -> same output within one run), via DataScrambler.get_scrambled_string.
name: Scramble

keep_first.description: Leading characters left visible; the rest are masked.

keep_last.description: Trailing characters left visible; the rest are masked.

output_field.description: Where to write the result. Defaults to target_field (in place) when omitted.

description: Writes `value` over the rule target_field. Plain text is written as is (e.g. "XXX-XX-XXXX"); `value` may also use {fill:X}, {lastN}, {firstN} to keep part of the original, e.g. {fill:X}{last4}.
name: Substitute Value

value.description: Text to write. Tokens: {fill:X} (pads to the original length), {last4}, {first2}. e.g. {fill:X}{last4}

output_field.description: Where to write the result. Defaults to target_field (in place) when omitted.

description: Removes the rule target_field entirely from the output record (legacy Skip semantics) instead of mutating its value.
name: Drop Field

description: Cascading 3-level model routing: Model Group -> Model (within that group) -> Version (of that model), backed by the precog fnf_model API (GET /fnf_model/model_groups/ -> GET /fnf_model/?model_group_id=:id -> GET /fnf_model/<model_slug>/version/). Version additionally offers a hardcoded 'Latest' option alongside the API-listed versions.

metadata.notes: 3-level cascading model routing action; params mirror custom_function's {name, reference_id} pointer convention.

name: Model Group / Model / Version Selector

model_group.description: {name, reference_id} of the selected model group.

version.description: {name, reference_id} of the selected version, or {name:'Latest', reference_id:'latest'}.
